scope: Expose bounded pre-output CLI diagnostics for explicit repair state, skipped DWG records, DXF text issue masks and the source $REQUIREDVERSIONS feature mask.

fields: sourceDxfTextIssueMask as a fixed-width 32-bit hexadecimal mask or not-applicable
sourceRequiredVersionsStatus and the exact 64-bit mask, plus output admission state
projection.limits: The diagnostic is bounded and read-only. It does not apply repairs or convert observations into a completeness/support claim.

runtimeInputs: A locally generated DXF with repeated $ACADVER HEADER structure is refused without changing its destination and is reported as repair-required.
A locally generated AC1021 DXF with $REQUIREDVERSIONS=1 targeting AC1024 exposes the exact mask and is refused atomically.
A locally authored AC1021 DXF text value triggers a nonzero decoder issue mask and reports exact-named codepage policy.
A locally authored AC1027 DWG contains one skipped custom class and one skipped unsupported object; strict export reports both counts and preserves the destination.
control.sourceGenerator: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp --generate-cli-skip-source authors the skipped-record DWG from scratch at runtime.

validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter $PWD/build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer $PWD/build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --fast-only (103 option controls, 47 batch controls, 2 read-observation controls, 6 partial-read controls, 4 source-disposition controls)

limits: Repair diagnosis covers DXF HEADER repeated-structure refusal only; the CLI did not repair any input.
Skip counts cover one generated AC1027 custom-class and unsupported-object pair, not all skip/recovery categories or revisions.
The $REQUIREDVERSIONS control covers one valid mask and an older-target refusal. Other malformed masks, masks with semantic consumers and native acceptance remain open.
The DXF text mask is decoder-issue telemetry, not a unique count of corrupt records or a semantic loss total.
